name: Gamelan
author: Erin Carter
description: A full-width rank of struck metallophone bars edge to edge across the frame, lengths graded so their tops form a ragged skyline. Each bar rings in its free-bar standing-wave modes - bright antinodes, pinned dark nodes - and a travelling flare climbs the bar on every hash-scheduled strike, while a persistent baseline glow keeps the whole wall resonating rather than flickering. Bars take graded palette hues left to right.

params.label: Strike gap
params.effect: Mean seconds between strikes on any one bar, from a busy gamelan ensemble shimmering all at once to rare lone notes ringing across a still wall.

params.label: Ring time
params.effect: How long a struck bar rings before decaying back to its baseline glow; short is a dry percussive tick, long a deep sustained bronze resonance.

params.label: Bar width
params.effect: Width of each bar in CSS pixels and so how many fill the wall - many slender keys at the minimum, a few broad slabs at the maximum.

params.label: Overtone
params.effect: Higher-mode shimmer content; 0 is a pure fundamental with a few calm antinodes, 1 stacks restless overtones for a brighter metallic glitter.
